Also with Eriogonum microthecum, Chrysothamnus viscidiflorus var. stenophyllus, Pediocactus sileri, Chaetopappa ericoides, Hilaria jamesii. Often found on low mounds (soil may accumulate under shrubs cover like a coppice dune).
